plan_item: 77.44.7.B — native cross-paragraph Rich Text text selection
finding: The recently released multi-block link browser test used programmatic Range.addRange() to create its selection. That verified model and link lifecycle behavior but did not verify that a real browser pointer drag selects the same text across paragraphs.
change: The existing Chromium test now scrolls the Inspector Rich Text surface into view, performs a real mouse drag across the end of the first paragraph and the beginning of the second, then reads the native Selection and canonical per-block segments.

The browser-generated selection continues through inline formatting, multi-block link insertion/removal, draft Save, reload, separate Publish and public-render assertions at 390px and 1366px viewport widths.
No runtime source, schema, dependency or production configuration changed.
